In April this year, OpenAI launched the upgraded image generation technology ChatGPT Images 2. Five months later, the company released an enhanced version, ChatGPT Images 2.5.

ChatGPT Images 2 represents a major leap forward from the company's earlier image generation tools.

It added 2K resolution output, support for multiple aspect ratios, and the ability to retrieve up-to-date information via web search. Images 2 also introduced non-Latin language processing capabilities, and offered two intelligence tiers: Instant and Thinking.

The latest Images 2.5 version boasts "sharper details, faster generation speeds, more precise editing features, and improved creation and sharing tools."

OpenAI stated: "Images 2.5 delivers more natural lighting effects and richer textures, better preserves the subjects in your reference photos, and more reliably follows editing instructions across multiple rounds of conversation."

"We have also reduced image generation latency by up to 50% compared to Images 2.0, allowing you to generate images and refine concepts more quickly."

Additionally, the company detailed a brand-new "Sketch" feature that lets users draw directly within ChatGPT and use it as a reference for image generation. OpenAI also introduced templates for popular image formats, a prompt sharing feature so others can try out your image generation ideas, and more.

Furthermore, OpenAI will offer developers two versions of Images 2.5 to build features into their applications. GPT-Image-2.5 Flare and GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst will be made available via OpenAI's API:

GPT‑Image‑2.5 Flare brings the same improvements in quality, editing, and speed to the API, and is the default choice for most applications, delivering higher-quality images with 50% lower latency than GPT‑Image‑2. It is suitable for a variety of scenarios including creator and social media content, product experiences, visual search, rapid image prototyping, and large-scale generation. GPT‑Image‑2.5 Sunburst is designed for high-end visual workflows that require finer control during the editing process, and can be used for creative and editorial workflows such as producing ready-to-go promotional assets or polished product images.

OpenAI stated: "Images 2.5 will be rolled out today on desktop, mobile, and web to all tiers of users across ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex." You can learn more about the new image generation technology here.

This ChatGPT Images 2.5 release follows last week's launch of GPT-6 Astra.
